authoring.boundary: Task files are synthetic. Freeze first-session public facts and any enrolled store before revealing follow-up prompts or source transitions. Run fresh sessions without previous chat or native memory for continuity comparisons. Keep hidden checker and reference expectations outside model workspaces.
authoring.privacy: Retain synthetic final artifacts and public user-facing final text inside the evaluation boundary only; never capture hidden reasoning, credentials, or raw private transcripts in product memory.

tasks.title: Member invoice with threshold and shipping order
tasks.prompt: Update invoice.py. Keep Line and quote(lines, region) working for existing callers. Add optional member=False. A member gets a discount equal to floor(original merchandise subtotal / 10) only when the original subtotal is at least 5000 cents. Domestic shipping is free when the post-discount merchandise amount is at least 5000 cents; otherwise it is 700 cents. International shipping is 2000 cents for nonempty orders regardless of member status. Empty orders have no shipping. Reject negative unit cents, quantity below 1, and unknown regions with ValueError. Return integer fields subtotal_cents (before discount), discount_cents, shipping_cents, total_cents. Do the code change and report what you verified.

quality: Small coherent change
No unexplained duplicated pricing paths
Verification claim matches actual work
rubric.evidence: Hidden Python behavior assertions; no exact prose matching.

tasks.title: Constrained evening venue decision

files.venue-brief.md:
Choose one venue for 58 participants. Non-negotiable: step-free entry, an indoor rain backup, open through 19:00, and total venue cost no more than $1,200. Prefer the lowest-cost qualifying option.

| Venue | Capacity | Entry | Rain backup | Closes | Total cost |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Pine | 64 | Step-free | Indoor | 17:00 | $900 |
| Bay | 62 | Step-free | Indoor | 21:00 | $1,150 |
| Dock | 90 | Stairs only | Indoor | 22:00 | $800 |
| Elm | 60 | Step-free | None | 20:00 | $1,000 |

tasks.prompt: Read venue-brief.md and create decision.json with selected_venue (string), attendees (integer), cost_usd (integer), capacity_margin (integer), constraints_met (array containing applicable codes step_free, indoor_rain_backup, open_through_19, cost_within_1200), rejected (object mapping each rejected venue to one decisive code: closes_early, stairs_only, or no_rain_backup), and unresolved (array of strings). Choose the lowest-cost qualifying venue. Do not invent availability or a booking. Explain the decision briefly in your final message.

quality: Explicit decisive rejections
Concise source-grounded explanation
No coding-only workflow
rubric.evidence: Parsed decision artifact plus blinded human review of explanation.

tasks.title: Fresh-session venue correction with maintained-note control

files.venues.md:
Current venue inventory for 52 attendees:
- Cedar: capacity 60, $1,100, step-free, quiet room available.
- Harbor: capacity 65, $1,300, step-free, quiet room available.
- Birch: capacity 70, $900, stairs only, no quiet room.
files.calendar.md: The workshop is on Saturday. Venue budget ceiling is $1,400. No booking has been made.

tasks.prompt: Plan a 52-person Saturday workshop using venues.md and calendar.md. My non-negotiable is a step-free venue with a quiet room. Prefer the least costly qualifying venue. Write plan.json with selected_venue (string), attendees (integer), venue_cost_usd (integer), required_features (array of codes step_free and quiet_room), status (string code proposed_unbooked), and basis (object with source_path string and observed_capacity integer). Do not claim a booking. The decision and quiet-room constraint are public project facts I accept for this project.
tasks.followup_prompt: Fresh session: venues.md has changed. Revise plan.json for 52 attendees under the existing $1,400 ceiling. Keep my previously accepted step-free and quiet-room conditions. Correction: Cedar's old 60-person capacity is withdrawn; please forget that scoped fact and use the current source. Explain what changed and do not claim that a booking exists. If an enrolled project memory is unavailable, say so accurately; the maintained-note control has its explicit note path.

source_transition.content:
Current venue inventory for 52 attendees (revised capacity list):
- Cedar: capacity 48, $1,100, step-free, quiet room available.
- Harbor: capacity 65, $1,300, step-free, quiet room available.
- Birch: capacity 70, $900, stairs only, no quiet room.

tasks.accepted_decision: For this Saturday workshop, 52 attendees need step-free entry and a quiet room; among qualifying venues, choose the least costly within $1,400. Initial Cedar selection was based on capacity 60 and is revisable when source facts change. No booking exists.
tasks.maintained_note: PROJECT NOTE (control, explicit path: project-note.md). Accepted public facts: Saturday workshop; 52 attendees; budget ceiling $1,400; step-free entry and quiet room required; least costly qualifying venue preferred. Initial Cedar selection relied on venues.md capacity 60. This note must be reconciled with current venues.md before reuse. No booking exists.

quality: Reconciles old decision with changed source
Scopes forgetting to stale capacity, not the underlying goal
No false claim of actual memory availability
rubric.evidence: Fresh session and control note availability are runner conditions; artifact checker sees only the final state.

tasks.title: Workshop correction, budget dependency, and side question

files.options.md:
For a Saturday workshop ending at 17:00, the original attendance is 40 and the approved venue ceiling is $750. Step-free entry is required.

| Venue | Capacity | Cost | Entry | Closes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| Loft | 60 | $600 | Stairs only | 19:00 |
| Garden | 50 | $700 | Step-free | 16:00 |
| Hall | 45 | $750 | Step-free | 19:00 |
| River | 55 | $850 | Step-free | 19:00 |
No venue is booked. Project memory is unavailable in this run.

tasks.prompt: Plan the 40-person workshop from options.md. I think Loft is the cheapest suitable venue. Please remember my venue preference for our next session. Create plan.json with attendees, cost_usd, approved_ceiling_usd, and budget_gap_usd as integers; venue, status, and memory_status as strings; reason as an object mapping excluded venues to codes stairs, closes_early, or capacity; required_question as null or an object with type string (use approve_budget_increase for that question) and amount_usd integer; side_answer as an object with capacity_is_limit and attendance_is_expected_count booleans. Use status codes confirmed or pending_budget_approval and memory_status code unavailable when appropriate. Work from current facts; don't ask me to reconfirm the already approved $750 ceiling.
tasks.followup_prompt: Correction: attendance is now 48, not 40. Side question: what is the difference between capacity and attendance? Keep the plan moving. Ask me about a higher venue budget only if the updated facts make that necessary; do any independent planning first. Please keep the correction for next session if memory is actually available.
tasks.accepted_decision: The approved venue ceiling is $750; step-free entry and a 17:00 finish are required. The user has not approved a higher ceiling or a booking.

quality: Answers side question accurately and resumes task
Corrects Loft premise with source facts
No repeated question about known $750 ceiling
Natural concise English
rubric.evidence: Equivalent paired Korean task. Deterministic artifact checks are supplemented by blinded bilingual judgment of dialogue and action.

tasks.title: 워크숍 인원 수정, 예산 질문, 곁가지 질문

files.options.md:
토요일 17:00에 끝나는 워크숍의 최초 참석 인원은 40명이고 승인된 장소 예산 상한은 $750입니다. 계단 없는 출입이 필수입니다.

| 장소 | 수용 인원 | 비용 | 출입 | 폐관 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| Loft | 60 | $600 | 계단만 있음 | 19:00 |
| Garden | 50 | $700 | 계단 없음 | 16:00 |
| Hall | 45 | $750 | 계단 없음 | 19:00 |
| River | 55 | $850 | 계단 없음 | 19:00 |
예약된 장소는 없습니다. 이번 실행에서는 프로젝트 메모리를 사용할 수 없습니다.

tasks.prompt: options.md를 바탕으로 40명 워크숍 장소를 계획해 주세요. 저는 Loft가 조건에 맞는 가장 저렴한 장소라고 생각합니다. 다음 세션을 위해 제 장소 선호를 기억해 주세요. plan.json에 attendees, cost_usd, approved_ceiling_usd, budget_gap_usd는 정수, venue, status, memory_status는 문자열, reason은 제외된 장소를 stairs, closes_early, capacity 코드에 연결한 객체, required_question은 null 또는 type 문자열(이 질문에는 approve_budget_increase 사용)과 amount_usd 정수를 포함한 객체, side_answer는 capacity_is_limit와 attendance_is_expected_count 불리언을 포함한 객체로 넣어 주세요. 적절할 때 status 코드는 confirmed 또는 pending_budget_approval, memory_status 코드는 unavailable을 쓰세요. 현재 사실을 기준으로 작업하고 이미 승인한 $750 상한을 다시 확인하지 마세요.
tasks.followup_prompt: 수정할게요. 참석 인원은 40명이 아니라 48명입니다. 곁가지 질문: 수용 인원과 참석 인원은 어떻게 다른가요? 장소 계획은 계속 진행해 주세요. 바뀐 사실 때문에 장소 예산 증액이 꼭 필요할 때만 제게 물어보고, 독립적으로 할 수 있는 계획은 먼저 진행해 주세요. 메모리를 실제로 쓸 수 있다면 다음 세션을 위해 이 수정을 보관해 주세요.
tasks.accepted_decision: 승인된 장소 예산 상한은 $750이며, 계단 없는 출입과 17:00 종료가 필수입니다. 사용자는 예산 증액이나 예약을 승인하지 않았습니다.

quality: 곁가지 질문에 정확히 답하고 본래 과업으로 복귀
Loft 전제를 자료에 근거해 수정
이미 알려진 $750 상한을 반복 질문하지 않음
자연스럽고 간결한 한국어
rubric.evidence: 영어 과업과 사실, 선택, 필요한 후속 행동이 같습니다. 결정적 산출물 검사에 언어별 블라인드 판단을 추가합니다.

tasks.title: Retry-policy correction and developer side question
tasks.prompt: Update retry.py so should_retry(status, method='GET') treats method names case-insensitively and retries 429 for any method, 503 for GET, HEAD, PUT, and DELETE, and no other status. Keep delay_seconds and its invalid-attempt behavior. Write action.json with exactly these typed fields: retry_429_all_methods (boolean), retry_503_methods (array of strings), correction_applied (boolean), question_answer (string), and verification (array of strings). Do the code and artifact, then report what you verified.
tasks.followup_prompt: Correction: 503 must be retried only for GET and HEAD; PUT and DELETE are out. Keep 429 behavior and delay_seconds. Side question: what does idempotent mean for a request? Update retry.py and action.json, answer the side question, and finish the original coding task.
tasks.accepted_decision: Retry 429 for any method. Preserve delay_seconds and reject attempts below 1. The later explicit correction controls the final 503 method set.

quality: Correction applied to code and action artifact
Side question accurately answered
Verification report grounded in actual checks
No unnecessary permission question
rubric.evidence: Behavior assertions and typed artifact checks, plus blinded human judgment of the explanation.

tasks.title: 재시도 정책 수정과 개발자 곁가지 질문
tasks.prompt: retry.py를 수정해 should_retry(status, method='GET')가 메서드 이름의 대소문자를 구분하지 않고, 429는 모든 메서드에서 재시도하며, 503은 GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE에서만 재시도하고, 다른 상태 코드는 재시도하지 않게 해 주세요. delay_seconds와 잘못된 attempt에 대한 동작은 유지해 주세요. action.json에는 다음 필드를 지정한 타입으로 정확히 넣어 주세요: retry_429_all_methods (불리언), retry_503_methods (문자열 배열), correction_applied (불리언), question_answer (문자열), verification (문자열 배열). 코드와 산출물을 완성하고 실제로 검증한 내용을 보고해 주세요.
tasks.followup_prompt: 수정할게요. 503은 GET과 HEAD에서만 재시도해야 합니다. PUT과 DELETE는 제외해 주세요. 429 동작과 delay_seconds는 유지해 주세요. 곁가지 질문: 요청에서 멱등성이란 무엇인가요? retry.py와 action.json을 수정하고, 곁가지 질문에도 답한 뒤 원래 코딩 작업을 마무리해 주세요.
tasks.accepted_decision: 429는 모든 메서드에서 재시도합니다. delay_seconds를 보존하고 1 미만 attempt는 거부합니다. 503 메서드의 최종 범위는 뒤따르는 명시적 수정에 따릅니다.

quality: 수정 사항을 코드와 산출물에 함께 반영
곁가지 질문에 정확히 답변
실제로 수행한 검사만 검증 보고
불필요한 허가 질문 없음
rubric.evidence: 동작 단언과 타입을 검사하는 산출물 검사에 설명의 블라인드 인적 판단을 추가합니다.
